method: Flesch–Kincaid estimated age = 0.39(words/sentence units) + 11.8(syllables/words) − 15.59 + 5. Each punctuated sentence or standalone task line is a sentence unit. Fixed syllable overrides plus a documented vowel-group heuristic; estimates, not learner assessments. Excludes staff notes, headings, file locators and codes. The word mat includes vocabulary labels. Words in definitions are included. Both editions share these pupil sentences. Target: BUILD estimate under 8.0 for each surface. Sentence starters are fragments and their numerical estimates have limited validity. All pupil locators and vocabulary labels are explicitly taught with visual support.
